feedback.fields: <instance> <the command as sent> | <instance> suspect:<ms> <the command as sent>

extensions.doc: request tags: a line may start with @<tag>, and its answer then starts with the same @<tag>
error words: a refusal resp <n> is followed by the stable word of its code, reply.<group>.<reason>, when the protocol declares one
event sequence numbers: every feedback line starts with #<n>, 1 for the first after this hello and one more for each, so a gap is a missed line

node_metadata.name: pretty_name
node_metadata.meaning: the name a graph client shows for the node: the plugin's name from its descriptor and the instance

node_metadata.name: instance
node_metadata.meaning: the instance the node hosts, which a client matches a hosted node on

node_metadata.name: labelled_name
node_metadata.meaning: the pretty-name of a node a client has labelled (node_label): the label, the plugin's name and the instance, in place of pretty_name until the label is cleared

hex.spelling: a number in hexadecimal, 0x and its digits, or 0

worker.spelling: a worker, w<k>, as worker_list names it

instances.spelling: instance numbers joined by ',', in order, or - for none

instance-or-none.spelling: an instance number, or - for none

status.spelling: exit:<status> for a process that exited, signal:<number> for one a signal ended

suspect.spelling: suspect:<ms>, the age of the reply

chain.spelling: a chain's number, or <plan>.<k> for segment k of a plan

placement.spelling: a placement, own | pool:<name> | chain:<chain> | default

line.spelling: the rest of the line, its words as they were sent

worker_states.name: given-up
worker_states.meaning: the storm bound is spent for its placement

constants.name: protocol_version
constants.meaning: the protocol version hello sends and answers on the socket; the table's version key is the same number

constants.name: default_command_port
constants.meaning: the command port without -p; the feedback port is the next one, unless -n is given

constants.name: connect_retry_ms
constants.meaning: how long the idle tick asks again for a connect a respawned worker could not make yet

constants.name: line_max
constants.meaning: the protocol socket's buffer: the longest pin_set line the daemon takes

constants.name: line_words_max
constants.meaning: the words of one command line the daemon reads, the verb included; a word past them is not read

constants.name: chain_members_min
constants.meaning: the fewest members of a chain: a chain of one is valid, so one isolated plugin is a chain like any other
